notes.title: Hotfix 0.6.1
notes.notes:
Just a few small hotfixes/improvements from the big update yesterday!

[list]
[*]Fixed un-collided terrain at the second location world
[*]Upscaled terrain in second location, making it look much better
[*][b]Achievements should now be working and update while in-game[/b]
[*]Fixed issue with instant delivery causing player the inability to order more paint
[*]Fixed issue with cameras going to the middle of nowhere (I think)
[*]Fixed achievement stats for money earned
[*]Fixed issue where if you ended the day with an order in progress the game would soft-lock
[/list]

Remember, if you find any bug reports, join [url=https://discord.gg/gDrVcvRYqj]our Discord[/url] and let us know! Also, in Discord, we give away free keys, talk about the game, and have an amazing community.

Thank you for all your patience in the development of Paint Desk Simulator!

~Splat Games

notes.title: New Location Update! Update 0.6.0
notes.notes:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Completely redone second location from Alpha Test, new location is now available for $1250 + $100 rent (lowered from 250)
[*]New day/night cycle, there is now actual night (with a moon, ooooooh)
[*]Added the ability to take multiple orders at once in the second location (with the implication of adding something very soon (there is a website once you reach the second location teasing the new addition coming)
[*]Made a display for the XP system (it's been secretly implemented for a while now)
[*]Added a new Easter Egg in the second world (in remembrance)
[*]Added new achievement for moving stores
[*]Added total earned in day to ColorfulChip's Casino allowing the player to know when they reached their daily limit
[*]Changed shelf upgrades having players purchase the wood ones before they get access to the metal shelves
[*]Added random shuffle to the NPCs allowing for more NPC types to be shown
[*]Added more NPC variations
[*]Added titles to the desktop, allowing for easier navigation
[*]Added new paint swatch wall
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added fix for soft locked NPCS in store
[*]Fixed issues with a very small change that NPCs would not come up to the counter and force the player to reload
[*]Fixed some rounding issues on StatSplat
[*]Fixed issues with the save/load controller that caused all data to be completely wiped
[*]Fixed issue with "Day Arriving" for certain items not displaying correctly
[*]Fixed issue with saving endlessly on Colorful Chip's Casino when reached max amount
[*]Fixed player movement on elevations higher than base
[*]Fixed NPCs sliding away from you when waiting for their order
[*]Changed door opening sound to not play when the store is full and a customer wants to shop
[*]Fixed issue when moving stores not saving correctly in the save/load controller
[/list]

notes.title: Paint Desk Simulator V0.5.1 // Bug fixes and QOL changes
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could pause during NPC dialogue
[*] Fixed an issue where using arrow keys during dialogue would move chat options in the incorrect direction
[*] Removed dialogue speed. Dialogue is now instant, making going into crippling debt a good bit easier
[*] Increased the size of the manual winter hitbox for inserting a paint can
[*] Started using and now displaying in-game the current version of Paint Desk Simulator
[*] The game automatically saves when cashing out or losing at Colorful Chip's Casino
[*] Added an option to quit to the main menu instead of fully closing out of the game (useful for bugs)
[*] Disabled time and customer movement when reading the tutorial for the first time
[*] [i]Potentially[/i] fixed the order camera to a normal position
[*] Fixed issue where the settings menu would open when opening the pause menu
[*] Fixed a spelling mistake on paint shelves
[*] Changed paint shelving into progressive shelves, instead of buying whichever you could afford
[*] Fixed issue where rapidly clicking on NPC chat with the banker would lock player in place
[*] Fixed an issue where customer would randomly leave even when they still had patience
[*] Increased patience time for customers.
[/olist]

If any bugs are found, please report them to the [url=https://discord.gg/fHPgbd6hJZ]Paint Desk Simulator Discord[/url], or, reach out via email at  yellowfreightpartners@gmail.com

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Added 2 hotfixes-

1) Added ability to use arrow keys and enter to chat with customers due to some issues with the dialogue controller causing an inability to chat with customers.

2) Increased default customer patience from 100 seconds to 150 seconds

notes.title: Paint Desk Simulator Beta Release Date, Giveaways, And More
notes.notes:
Tuesday, the 21st of November will mark one month until the release of Paint Desk Simulator's Beta! We at Splat Games are super excited to unveil our game. As time winds down we wanted to announce a few things! 

First and foremost, thank you for your support for Paint Desk Simulator, we have already reached more wishlists than we expected. We're almost as excited as you all are! 

Secondly, We want to announce again our Discord! [url=https://discord.gg/qc6whPtENv]Link[/url]. This Discord will be hosting a very special giveaway! We will be releasing Steam keys a few days before the release of Paint Desk Simulator so someone may get a free Steam key of P.D.S. as well as a headstart in being able to play Paint Desk Simulator. 

Third, we will be starting to market this game on TikTok soon! Follow our account at [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@splatgames2?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc]Splat Games TikTok[/url]. On top of this, once we have the game in a playable state (working on order dialogue) we will try to get a few content creators on the scene! 

Finally, I would like to thank you all again. All the Paint Slingers here are amazing. The support we have received has been overwhelming, to say the least. I am excited to see how you all perceive the game at launch! 

~Jake
Splat Games
